jobs.make-all:
name: Application checks
    needs: [changes, platform-contracts, mac-runner, elixir-checks, claude-checks]
    if: ${{ always() }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Require a complete classification decision
        env:
          RESULT: ${{ needs.changes.result }}
          CODE: ${{ needs.changes.outputs.application }}
          CLAUDE: ${{ needs.changes.outputs.claude }}
          ELIXIR_RESULT: ${{ needs.elixir-checks.result }}
          CLAUDE_RESULT: ${{ needs.claude-checks.result }}
          POLICY: ${{ needs.changes.outputs.policy }}
          READY: ${{ needs.changes.outputs.ready }}
          NPM: ${{ needs.changes.outputs.npm }}
          READINESS: ${{ needs.changes.outputs.readiness }}
          CONFIG: ${{ needs.changes.outputs.codex_config }}
          CONTRACTS: ${{ needs.changes.outputs.contracts }}
          PROCESS_RESULT: ${{ needs.platform-contracts.result }}
          MAC_RUNNER_RESULT: ${{ needs.mac-runner.result }}
        run: |
          test "$RESULT" = success
          test "$MAC_RUNNER_RESULT" = success
          case "$CODE" in true|false) ;; *) exit 1 ;; esac
          case "$POLICY" in true|false) ;; *) exit 1 ;; esac
          for flag in "$CLAUDE" "$READY" "$NPM" "$READINESS" "$CONFIG" "$CONTRACTS"; do
            case "$flag" in true|false) ;; *) exit 1 ;; esac
          done
          if [ "$CODE" = true ] || [ "$CLAUDE" = true ]; then test "$POLICY" = true; fi
          for family in elixir claude; do
            if [ "$family" = elixir ]; then selected=$CODE; observed=$ELIXIR_RESULT;
            else selected=$CLAUDE; observed=$CLAUDE_RESULT; fi
            if [ "$selected" = true ] && [ "$READY" = true ]; then
              test "$observed" = success
            else
              test "$observed" = skipped
            fi
            if [ -n "${GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY:-}" ]; then
              echo "$family family: selected=$selected, ready=$READY, result=$observed (success means executed; skipped means omitted or deferred)." >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
            fi
          done
          if [ "$NPM" = true ] || [ "$READINESS" = true ] || [ "$CONFIG" = true ] || [ "$CONTRACTS" = true ]; then
            test "$POLICY" = true
          fi
          if [ "$NPM" = true ] || [ "$CONTRACTS" = true ]; then
            test "$PROCESS_RESULT" = success
          else
            test "$PROCESS_RESULT" = skipped
          fi
      - name: Check out source
        if: needs.changes.outputs.policy == 'true'
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - name: Workflow and metadata regressions
        if: needs.changes.outputs.policy == 'true'
        run: python3 -m unittest discover -s scripts/ci/tests -v

      - name: Validate all workflow and composite action definitions
        if: needs.changes.outputs.policy == 'true'
        run: |
          curl -fsSL --retry 3 https://github.com/rhysd/actionlint/releases/download/v1.7.12/actionlint_1.7.12_linux_amd64.tar.gz -o "$RUNNER_TEMP/actionlint.tar.gz"
          echo "8aca8db96f1b94770f1b0d72b6dddcb1ebb8123cb3712530b08cc387b349a3d8  $RUNNER_TEMP/actionlint.tar.gz" | sha256sum -c -
          tar -xzf "$RUNNER_TEMP/actionlint.tar.gz" -C "$RUNNER_TEMP" actionlint
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/actionlint" -shellcheck= -pyflakes=

      - name: Codex readiness regressions
        if: needs.changes.outputs.readiness == 'true'
        run: python3 runner/test_codex_readiness.py
      - name: Codex file and mount policy regressions
        if: needs.changes.outputs.codex_config == 'true'
        run: python3 scripts/ci/release_tests.py codex-config
      - name: Npm configuration semantics
        if: needs.changes.outputs.npm == 'true'
        run: python3 runner/test_npm_cache.py
      - name: Require ready application qualification
        env:
          APPLICATION: ${{ needs.changes.outputs.application }}
          CLAUDE: ${{ needs.changes.outputs.claude }}
          READY: ${{ needs.changes.outputs.ready }}
        run: |
          if { [ "$APPLICATION" = true ] || [ "$CLAUDE" = true ]; } && [ "$READY" = false ]; then
            echo 'Draft PR: affected application family qualification deferred; this required context remains non-passing until ready qualification succeeds.' >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
            exit 1
          fi
      - name: Application qualification omission
        if: needs.changes.outputs.application == 'false' && needs.changes.outputs.claude == 'false'
        run: echo "No application inputs changed; behavioral checks intentionally omitted, not executed." >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
      - name: Documentation policy omission
        if: needs.changes.outputs.policy == 'false'
        run: echo "Human-facing documentation only; CI regression suites and workflow/toolchain setup intentionally omitted, not executed." >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
jobs.elixir-checks:
name: Elixir quality, build and full coverage
    needs: changes
    if: needs.changes.outputs.application == 'true' && needs.changes.outputs.ready == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - name: Check out source
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - name: Set up mise tools
        if: needs.changes.outputs.application == 'true' && needs.changes.outputs.ready == 'true'
        uses: jdx/mise-action@8418fedb1110381a0d3ba51a7a415d7c1b884550 # v5.2.2
        with:
          install: true
          cache: true
          working_directory: elixir

      - name: Cache deps and build
        if: needs.changes.outputs.application == 'true' && needs.changes.outputs.ready == 'true'
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: |
            elixir/deps
            elixir/_build
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-mix-${{ hashFiles('elixir/mix.lock') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-mix-

      - name: Verify full Elixir family
        if: needs.changes.outputs.application == 'true' && needs.changes.outputs.ready == 'true'
        working-directory: elixir
        run: make elixir-ci
